label: Diagram 10.1
caption: Diagram 10.1 Pipes penetrating fire-separating elements
description: The drawing is a section titled 'Diagram 10.1 Pipes penetrating fire-separating elements', with the text 'See para 10.5' at the top left. It shows a vertical grey fire-separating element, labelled 'Fire-separating element' at the top, with a horizontal pipe passing through it. Green blocks of fire-stopping fill the gap above and below the pipe where it passes through the element; the lower one is labelled 'Fire-stopping'. The label 'Pipe specification (b)' points to the thin outer pipe on the left, and 'Sleeve (or pipe) of specification (a) to be in contact with pipe' points to the thicker sleeve around the pipe on the right. Two horizontal double‑headed dimension lines above the pipe, each reading '≥ 1000mm', give the length of the sleeve on each side of the fire-separating element. To the right, a NOTES block lists three points: make the opening in the fire-separating element as small as possible and provide fire-stopping between pipe and fire-separating element; see Table 10.1 for materials specification; the sleeve should be class A1 rated. A green footer strip repeats the diagram title.
